(a) The Tenderer having minimum 05 ( Five) years general experience of Electro--Mechanical works .
(b) The Tenderer shall have successfully Completed of 01 (One ) No. Electrical Works of Minimum Amount Tk. 5.00 (Five)
Lac single Contract within last 05 ( Five) years Under in Govt./ Semi Govt./ Autonomous Organization. i.e Counting

(c) The Minimum Amount of Liquid Assets or Working Capital or Credit Lines of the Tenderer shall be Tk. 5.00 (Five)
Lac only.
(d) Annual Electro - Mechanical Turnover : Last five years ( Financial year 2020-2021, 2021-2022 , 2022-2023, 2023-2024,
2024-2025 ) Average Annual Turnover should be required Minimum Amount Tk. 7.00 (Seven) Lac.
(e) Tenderer must have up-to-date ABC Category Contractory & Electrical Supervisory License from Bangladesh
Electrical Licensing Board.
(f) The Tenderer must have Income Tax Clearance Certificate (2024-2025).
(g) The Tenderer must have VAT/BIN Registration Certificate.
(h) The Tenderer must have valid Trade License (2025-2026)
